You may feel overwhelmed, not know where to start, or struggle to find meaning in what you’re going through. In those moments, having a space to pause, breathe, and make sense of what’s happening can make all the difference. Therapy is not only for when “everything is falling apart,” it’s also a tool to know yourself better, make clearer decisions, and take conscious care of yourself.<1> My approach combines the emotional with the practical. It’s not just about talking, but about understanding how you work, why you feel the way you do, and what you can do to start feeling better. ","about2.content2":"<0>In our sessions we work with concrete tools, tailored to you, that help you face what worries you, improve your relationships, and restore your well-being. And all of this from a place of respect, active listening, and without judgment.<1>If you live abroad, have a busy schedule, or simply prefer the comfort of your home, online therapy can be a great option. It maintains the closeness and depth of therapeutic work, but with the flexibility you need. In addition, by offering sessions in Spanish and English, I can support you wherever you are, without language or distance being a barrier.","about2.cta":"About me","footer.slogan.title":"Your emotional well-being is an investment, not an expense.","footer.slogan.subtitle":"If you feel it’s time to take a step towards caring for yourself and your relationships, this is your space.","footer.copyrights":"All rights reserved.","footer.links.title":"Quick links","footer.links.home":"Home","footer.links.about":"About me","footer.links.services":"Services","footer.links.faq":"FAQ","footer.links.contact":"Contact","footer.contact.title":"Contact","footer.contact.address":"Madrid, Spain","footer.contact.email":"<0>info@latitude.es","footer.contact.phone":"+34 916 696 8370","footer.contact.workHours":"<0>Monday to Friday: 8:30 am to 7:00 pm

Life constantly challenges us, and we don’t always have the tools or support we need to face it. In individual therapy, we work together to understand what’s happening to you, ease your distress, and strengthen your personal resources.

","service.area.2.title":"Couples therapy","service.area.2.content":"

Relationships can be a source of support, but also of conflict and strain. If you feel something isn’t working, if communication is difficult, or if you’re stuck in harmful dynamics, therapy can help you reconnect.

","service.feature.title":"Care modalities","service.feature.content.1":"In person – in my office in the north of Madrid, a calm and welcoming environment.","service.feature.content.2":"Online – with the same quality, adapted to your schedule and circumstances.","service.feature.cta":"Book your first session","service.feature.1.title":"Individual therapy","service.feature.1.content":"<0><0>Depression <2>Anxiety<3>Life crisis<4>Self-esteem<5>Self-knowledge","service.feature.2.title":"Couples therapy (Gottman Method)","service.feature.2.content":"<0><0>Decreased sexual desire<1>Differences in emotional or physical needs<2>Feelings of rejection or disconnection<3>Life projects<4>Jealousy management","ServicePrice.Title":"Prices","ServicePrice.content":"Seleccionar Servicio","ServicePrice.1.title":"Individual Therapy","ServicePrice.1.content":"I offer individual therapy sessions for adults, focused on areas such as anxiety, depression, self-esteem, grief, emotional regulation, and personal growth.","ServicePrice.duration":"Duration","ServicePrice.1.duration":"50 min","ServicePrice.price":"Price","ServicePrice.1.price":"70,00 €","ServicePrice.1.specialRate":"Special rate: €60.00 if you come recommended by someone who has already worked with me or knows my work.","ServicePrice.2.title":"Couples Therapy","ServicePrice.2.content":"Couples therapy provides a safe space to work on communication, conflicts, emotional connection, and shared growth within the relationship.","ServicePrice.2.duration":"50 min","ServicePrice.2.price":"80,00 €","ServicePrice.2.specialRate":"Special rate: €60.00 if you come recommended by someone who has already worked with me or knows my work.","ServicePrice.note.title":"Note","ServicePrice.note.content":"I value the network of trust that grows around this work. If you have questions or would like to explore other options, feel free to write to me — we’ll talk with no commitment.","slider.title.top":"Clinical psychologist","slider.title.bottom":"in Madrid and online","slider.title.slogan":"A professional space to care for your mental health and relationships","slider.cta":"Book your first session","stepper.title":"How therapy works","stepper.content":"

I know starting therapy can bring doubts, nerves, or even a bit of fear. That’s why I want you to know that the process is designed so you feel supported from the very first moment, with clarity, respect, and no pressure. Each step is adapted to you, your pace, and your needs.

","stepper.1.title":"First session: getting to know each other","stepper.1.content":"The first session is a space where you can tell me what brought you here, what worries you, and what you’d like to achieve.
You can also ask me anything you need about how I work, what to expect, and how the sessions will be. You don’t need to have it all figured out: we are here to explore together.","stepper.2.title":"Assessment and treatment plan","stepper.2.content":"After getting to know you better, we do an initial assessment that helps us understand your situation more clearly.
From there, I provide you with clear feedback and we design a personalized treatment plan together. This plan is not rigid: it adapts to you, your goals, and your progress.","stepper.3.title":"Therapy sessions","stepper.3.content":"In sessions we use practical, evidence-based tools that you can apply in your daily life.
It’s not only about talking, but about learning strategies to manage what’s happening to you, make clearer decisions, and build sustainable change. Each session is a space to move forward, reflect, and take care of yourself.","stepper.4.title":"Follow-up and closure","stepper.4.content":"As you start feeling better, we review your progress and talk about how to keep taking care of yourself outside of sessions.
The goal is for you to become more autonomous, with your own resources and a deeper understanding of yourself. Closure is not a goodbye, but a transition towards sustained well-being.","stepper.footer.content":"<0>Confidentiality guaranteed Everything we talk about in session is protected by law. Your privacy and emotional safety are an absolute priority.","stepper.cta":"Start your process","teams.jobTitle":"Health Psychologist - M-42801","workOnline.category":"Online therapy","workOnline.title1":"Online therapy","workOnline.content1":"Online therapy is not a “plan B”; it is just as valid and effective as in-person therapy in most cases. In fact, many people prefer it for its convenience, flexibility, and the possibility of accessing psychological support no matter where they are.","workOnline.title2":"When can it be ideal?","workOnline.content2":"<0>If you live outside Madrid or in another country.<1>If you travel frequently and need continuity in your process.<2>If you have a busy schedule and need sessions to fit into your routine.<3>If you prefer to avoid commuting and save time.<4>With just a device with a camera, headphones, and a stable connection, you can have your session from home, the office, or even while traveling. What matters is not the place, but that you feel in a safe, comfortable, and interruption-free space.","workOnline.title3":"And what about the therapeutic bond?","workOnline.content3":"The emotional connection and depth of therapeutic work are not lost through a screen. My way of working ensures you feel heard, understood, and supported, wherever you are. Thank you for trusting 💛","faq.q1":"How long does a session last?","faq.a1":"Each session lasts 50 minutes. It’s enough time for you to express yourself calmly, work in depth, and leave with clear ideas to apply in your daily life.","faq.q2":"How often should I come?","faq.a2":"At the beginning, it’s most common to have weekly sessions, as that allows continuity and more solid progress. Over time, depending on your progress, we can adjust the frequency: biweekly, monthly, or according to your needs.","faq.q3":"What if I don’t feel comfortable?","faq.a3":"It’s completely normal to have doubts or not feel entirely comfortable at first. You can tell me at any time. My priority is that the space adapts to you, and that you feel safe to talk about what truly matters to you. Therapy is a collaborative process, and your voice matters.","faq.q4":"Can I switch from online to in-person?","faq.a4":"Yes, of course. If at any point you prefer to move from online to in-person sessions (or vice versa), we can discuss and arrange it depending on availability and location. What’s important is that the format fits your life and makes the process easier for you.","faq.q5":"Is therapy confidential?","faq.a5":"Absolutely. Everything you share in session is protected by data protection law and the professional ethical code. Confidentiality is a fundamental basis of therapeutic work, and you can trust that your privacy is safeguarded.","faq.q6":"Do I need to prepare anything before coming?","faq.a6":"You don’t need to prepare anything. But if it helps, you can write down topics you’d like to discuss, questions you may have, or situations that concern you. Sometimes writing things down helps organize ideas and make the most of session time.","faq.q7":"How do I know if I need therapy?","faq.a7":"You don’t need to be “at your worst” to start therapy. Sometimes you just feel that something isn’t right, that it’s hard to manage certain emotions, or that you’d like to understand yourself better. Other times, there’s a specific situation that overwhelms you: a breakup, a big change, a loss, a conflict... Whatever it is, if you’re considering it, there’s probably something inside you asking to be heard. Therapy can help you if: • You feel stuck, confused, or blocked. • You’re going through a hard time and need emotional support. • You want to improve your relationship with yourself or others. • You struggle with decision-making or managing stress. • You simply want to know yourself better and live with more calm and clarity. You don’t need to have it all figured out to start. In fact, many times the first step is exactly that: allowing yourself to explore, without pressure or judgment.","faq.q8":"What if I don’t know where to start?","faq.a8":"That’s okay. In the first session you don’t need to have a prepared speech or know exactly what to say. You can come with your doubts, your silences, your questions. I’m here to help you make sense of things, understand what’s happening, and build a path that makes sense for you.","breadcrumbs.faq":"FAQ","faq.title":"Frequently asked questions","faq.content":"I know starting therapy can bring up many questions. One of my pillars is the Gottman Method for couples therapy, supported by more than 40 years of research. This model doesn’t just “talk about problems”: it provides a clear, structured method to improve communication, strengthen the emotional bond, and prevent breakups.","sobremi.title2":"My way of working","sobremi.content3":"Each person and relationship is unique. That’s why I adapt therapy to your story, your needs, and your pace.","sobremi.frase":"For me, therapy is like taking care of a garden: I accompany you in planting and watering, but the growth pace is uniquely yours.","sobremi.content4":"In my practice you’ll find","sobremi.content4.feature1.title":"Closeness","sobremi.content4.feature1.content":"Feeling heard from the very first moment.","sobremi.content4.feature2.title":"Collaboration","sobremi.content4.feature2.content":"We work as a team, not as spectator and therapist.","sobremi.content4.feature3.title":"Clarity","sobremi.content4.feature3.content":"You will always know the purpose of each exercise or strategy.","sobremi.content4.feature4.title":"Adapted pace","sobremi.content4.feature4.content":"We start weekly and adjust as you progress.","seo.servicios.terapiapareja.title":"Couples therapy","breadcrumbs.terapiapareja":"Couples therapy","servicio.terapiapareja.title":"Couples therapy","servicio.terapiapareja.content":"Relationships can be a source of support, but also of conflict and strain. I work with the Gottman Method, an evidence-based approach that provides practical and effective tools to improve relationships.","servicio.terapiapareja.list":"What can we work on?","servicio.terapiapareja.content2":"Each couple has its own story, challenges, and strengths. My role is to help you understand what’s happening and find healthier, more respectful ways of relating.","seo.servicios.terapiaindividual.title":"Individual therapy","breadcrumbs.terapiaindividual":"Individual therapy","servicio.terapiaindividual.title":"Individual therapy","servicio.terapiaindividual.content":"Life constantly challenges us, and we don’t always have the tools or support we need to face it. In individual therapy, we work together to understand what’s happening to you, ease your distress, and strengthen your personal resources.","servicio.terapiaindividual.list.title":"Some of the most common reasons people come to therapy are:","servicio.terapiaindividual.list":"<0>Anxiety, stress, and panic attacks that interfere with your daily life.<1>Feelings of sadness, emptiness, or lack of motivation.<2>Doubts about yourself, insecurity, or low self-esteem.<3>Grief processes or significant losses.<4>Difficulty managing intense emotions like anger, guilt, or fear.","servicio.terapiaindividual.content2":"In individual therapy we don’t just aim to relieve distress, but to understand where it comes from and prevent it from returning. It’s not only about “removing the symptom,” but about understanding what causes it, how it persists, and what you can do so it doesn’t take control again. I support you so you can reconnect with yourself, make clearer decisions, and regain your well-being.","OurTeam.team.title":"","footer.siteTitle":""}
